methodology: Composite score weighted: Best Beyer Speed Figure (40%) — primary predictor, every Derby winner since 2000 has posted 100+; Prep race points/quality (25%); Career earnings efficiency (15%); Trainer Churchill Downs win rate (10%); Post position historical bias (10%). Market edge = model probability minus devigged morning line implied probability.
key_filter: Every Kentucky Derby winner since 2000 has posted at least one 100+ Beyer Speed Figure. Horses below 100 are faded on win bets regardless of other factors.

model_notes: Key finding: Further Ado and Commandment are clear class of field on Beyer figures. Renegade is the most overbet horse at 4-1 with a sub-100 Beyer. Emerging Market at 15-1 is the best overlay combining improving trajectory, elite connections, and favorable post. The hard Beyer filter (100+) eliminates roughly 75% of the field from win consideration based on historical Derby winner data since 2000.
